subject: Re: Example Case
text:
The data types involved are basic: binary options, checkboxes, and radio buttons, all derived from a PDF rulebook. We've extracted the relevant rules for the CRA and individual states to create a questionnaire. This is handed off to labeling analysts, who conduct research and check the appropriate boxes if applicable. There is no other form of data - no images, no multimodal inputs, no point cloud, just straightforward annotation with a text box for reasoning and citations when known.
